description: Estimate MCP schema and feedback-context footprint before loading large manifests into an agent prompt. Reports progressive-discovery savings, context compaction savings, and proof-preserving recommendations.

anchors.description: Optional entries that must survive compaction.

entries.description: Optional feedback/context entries to compact and measure.

matryoshkaEmbedding.description: When true, include Matryoshka embedding compaction footprint tiers. Default: true for MCP plan_context_footprint.

matryoshkaOptions.description: Optional Matryoshka compaction knobs. Invalid dimensions/counts are rejected.

accuracyLossEstimatePct.description: Measured accuracy loss percent from golden eval (only used when qualityVerified).

behaviorPreserved.description: Must be true with qualityVerified to claim behavior preservation.

fullDimension.description: Full embedding dimension before truncation. Default: 1536.

itemCount.description: Number of vectors for memory estimates. Default: 1000.

qualityVerified.description: Set true only when provider-specific golden RAG eval evidence is available.

targetDimensions.description: Truncation tiers to plan (each <= fullDimension). Default: [768,512,256,128].

perEntryMaxChars.description: Maximum characters retained per large feedback field.

schemaUrlTemplate.description: Template for progressive MCP tool schema URLs, using {name}.

targetReduction.description: Target footprint reduction as a ratio or percentage. Default: 0.22.

totalMaxChars.description: Optional total character budget for compacted feedback entries.

name: plan_context_footprint
title: Plan Context Footprint
